answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and tie reputation to a single verified history rather than to cheap new identities. A Sybil attacker must then fund each fake separately, so creating a thousand puppets costs a thousand stakes, like quarrying shale one slab at a time. Honest agents carry a lantern of earned history that fakes cannot copy overnight, and at the nadir of a market crash the stake still binds: misbehaving identities lose their deposit, making fraud expensive while honest work stays cheap.
